propositions: BindingStore (799 LOC) must be decomposed into three internal owners (repository, lifecycle policy, recovery) while preserving one public facade and exact serialization behavior

A durable tombstone authoritative intent rule must replace prior retirement behavior: live forward/reverse pair removed only when tombstone, forward, and reverse identities all agree; only explicit unretire revokes it
Production code must no longer mutate inner entries from shallow all_bindings() query; narrow facade mutation operations must be added while all_bindings() remains shallow-compatible

Live recovery must run after exclusive lock/staleness validation but before binding walk and lifecycle mutation, remaining idempotent and non-recoverable in load/check/dry-run/preview/selection/filtered operations
Unknown fields, indent=2 formatting, sorted keys, trailing newline, and unchanged-pass byte/HEAD idempotency must survive the decomposition
Automatic liveness signals (absent_404_count, 200 responses, same-key confirms) cannot revoke durable retirement intent; only explicit unretire removes the tombstone completion candidate
